protocol.mlip: MACE-MP-0 (small) baseline, un-fine-tuned -- same potential/protocol as the Li6PS5Cl baseline so the cross-lead ranking is internally consistent
protocol.md: NVT Langevin, 1 fs, friction 0.01/fs, 600/800/1000 K, 150 ps + 10 ps equil (the tier at which the 52-atom Li6PS5Cl baseline was convergence-verified)
protocol.note: sigma is screening-grade (order of magnitude + ranking), NOT production-grade; the Li6PS5Cl fine-tuned model is system-specific and deliberately NOT used here.

li20si3p3s23cl.provenance: P1 MP screen + 15-hit adversarial audit (screen_audit.md); LGPS-family literature-blank lead. 3 polymorphs rank top-3 of the whole screen; this mp-id has the lowest MP e_above_hull (0.0305 eV/atom, band gap 2.31 eV). P1 predicted log10(sigma)=-4.63 (coarse prior).

li8tis6.provenance: P1 MP screen lead #2 (literature-blank). MP e_above_hull=0.0035 eV/atom, band gap 2.29 eV, spacegroup 185. P1 predicted log10(sigma)=-4.77.

li3ps4_gen016.provenance: MatterGen Li-P-S conditional generation (Vanda job 1215079), label gen_016: NOVEL Li3PS4 polymorph (beta-Li3PS4 is a known fast-ion conductor), MACE self-consistent hull e_above_hull=0.006 eV/atom (essentially on-hull), S.U.N.=True. P3/P1 predicted log10(sigma)=-6.83.

lips3_gen021.provenance: MatterGen label gen_021: LiPS3, MLIP-predicted NEW ground state (e_above_hull=-0.031 eV/atom on the MACE self-consistent hull), S.U.N.=True. P3/P1 predicted log10(sigma)=-7.12.
